Download cargo artifacts

Download the .crate file of a crate version from a Cargo registry. rp reads
&lt;repo&gt;/config.json, then the sparse index file of the crate (one JSON line for
each published version), picks the version, and downloads it from the "dl"
address of config.json (&lt;repo&gt;/api/v1/crates/&lt;crate&gt;/&lt;version&gt;/download). The
index publishes the SHA-256 of every crate, and the download is verified
against it.

Without --version rp takes the highest release that is not yanked, else the
highest pre-release that is not yanked. A version named with --version is
downloaded even when it is yanked, as cargo does for a locked version. The
server keeps crate names in lower case with '_' in place of '-', so rp
download cargo my-crate finds the crate published as my_crate. The file is
stored as &lt;crate&gt;-&lt;version&gt;.crate, with the crate spelled as you wrote it.

The token is sent when the repository asks for it: as Basic (the default for
Repsy), or as the scheme --auth-scheme names (basic, bearer, raw).

```
rp download cargo <crate> [flags]
```

## Options

```
      --auth-scheme string   Send the token as basic, bearer or raw (without a scheme) when the repository asks for it (default: the scheme the server's challenge names)
      --dir string           Directory to store the file in (created when missing) (default ".")
      --force                Replace the file when it already exists
      --repo string          Repository to download from (required)
      --version string       Version to download (default: the newest the format knows)
```
